about: PROPOSED baselines for the world master gate, for the owner's sign-off (KPC owner, 2026-11-11, after run 43082247085). The gate NEVER reads this file. To approve: check each copy, fill copy_sha256 with the sha256 of that exact W-XX.json.gz on the boundary-cache release, set approved_by to 'KPC owner' and approved_date to the day, remove what you do not approve, and save it as data/outlines/world-baselines.approved.json in a reviewed PR. The gate (kpc_master_cli.py gate --approved) then checks each listed copy EXACTLY against expected_count (fewer records = short = moved aside). An entry without a real copy_sha256, or a file without a sign-off, is not read at all (fail closed: the layers.json baselines apply). This file is the bridge for copies uploaded before copies carried their own manifest; a hand bundle re-made with `kpc_master_cli.py bundle-manifest` is checked against its own manifest and needs no entry here. Counts: the gate's own 'read N of M' lines in run 43082247085 (N = records in the copy).
